acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or disprove pre-allocation HTML size refusal using an oversized immutable fixture and allocation/header evidence.
If confirmed, admit source limits before body allocation and retain omitted/excluded lexical inputs in a machine-readable form.
Preserve flow identity/relocation and existing caller compatibility; add focused tests and independent review.
body: Source evidence from independent #389 review at public25971bda1ca1664d8a546d751cb2bb9bbd454daf: internal/flowdocs/generate.go110-116 calls auth.BlobBytes for scoped HTML then checks its 4MiB bound after allocation. Native contextindex admits at most1000000-byte sources but flowdocs does not copy index exclusions into Manifest.Gaps, so callers cannot treat the default gap list as complete input coverage. Runtime allocation exploit reproduction NOT_RUN; suspected bounded-reader defect, confirmed adapter information gap. Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 / Tasksbuild202. #389 separately refuses scoped HTML before Generate/Open/CheckRevision and retains scoped native exclusions; this does not repair existing flowdocs callers. Evidence /tmp/delta-source-review.json SRC-01/02 and internal/delta/regression_test.go. Native search HTML found no owning bound issue. Preserve existing identity/relocation contracts.
title: Qualify bounded HTML flowdocs reads and expose omitted lexical inputs
